profile.summary:
Experienced with HTML5, CSS3 (Sass and LESS) and JavaScript (AngularJS, ReactJS, NodeJS, Jquery), AEM (Adobe Experience Manager), responsive web design, UX, UI, usability, accessibility, testing and developing across multiple browsers while maintaining a consistent and accessible user experience.
